verification.instructions: 1) Re-download the four DocSouth ZIPs from https://docsouth.unc.edu/docsouthdata/ . 2) Re-run scripts/docsouth_harvest.py to produce docsouth.ndjson. 3) sha256sum docsouth.ndjson should equal corpus_sha256. 4) Re-form via POST /api/range-form with corpus_path, compute_persistence, use_runpod, seed=42. The response_digest is invariant under (corpus_sha256, model_id_within_tenant, seed).
